title: Install the platform binary
note: Or grab a binary directly from carlosframework/releases.

title: Build your app for the target host
Ship, promote, route
cmd:
carlos ship -app myapp -version $(git rev-parse --short HEAD) myapp-binary
carlos promote -app myapp <version> stable
carlos add -app myapp -kind instance myapp.yourdomain.com
note: The same sequence — against a real S3-backed bucket, a real edge, a real certificate — that put rastrillo's own example live at hello.bdf.oncarlos.com. Standing up the box, bucket, and DNS is the one-off part; from then on every deploy is ship then promote.
